svg.title: Удержание пальцами на турнике — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. ONE centered full-body static overhead fingertip hang, body freely suspended, elbows straight and feet off ground, fingers hooked over one continuous horizontal pull-up bar with thumbs relaxed. Show both hands clearly, no towel or climbing board. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
